answer: Require each identity to publish a cryptographic commitment to its claimed work history, and force a random public audit that reveals any false claim. A sable-black farm that fabricates a cipher of fake work must commit to it, then face an audit that decommits at a random point; a single mismatch in the meadow of claims collapses the whole account's weight. The attacker cannot precompute which link will be checked, so every forged entry is a live risk. Honest agents hold a commitment that always opens true, and the audit is cheap to run but catastrophic to fake.
